SourceProxy.label: SHYX Mesh Simplification
SourceProxy.name: SHYXMeshSimplification

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Mesh Simplification: CGAL edge collapse with a selectable algorithm.

SourceProxy.Documentation:
One CGAL edge_collapse pass on a triangle vtkPolyData. Algorithm selects cost and placement. Stop criterion, boundary edges, and sharp edges apply to every algorithm. Vertices incident to a constrained edge are not moved; if both endpoints are, that collapse is refused. Constrained edges themselves are not collapsed.
Not SHYX Adaptive Isotropic Remesher. SHYX Edge Collapse and SHYX Subset Coarsen remain separate filters. Input must be a pure triangle mesh; use Triangulate upstream for mixed cells.

IntVectorProperty.name: StopCriterion
IntVectorProperty.label: Stop criterion
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: How far to collapse. Edge count ratio: stop when remaining undirected edges / initial edges falls below Edge Count Ratio. Edge count: stop when the undirected edge count falls below Edge Count. Edge length: stop when the next edge to collapse is strictly longer than Edge Length (with edge-length cost this keeps only shorter edges; with other costs a long low-cost edge can stop the sequence while shorter edges remain).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: EdgeCountRatio
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Edge count ratio
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Stop when (current undirected edges) / (initial undirected edges) is strictly below this value. Default 0.5. Constraints or the link condition may stop earlier.

IntVectorProperty.name: EdgeCount
IntVectorProperty.label: Edge count
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Stop when the undirected edge count falls strictly below this value. 0 collapses until nothing else is legal. Constraints or the link condition may stop earlier.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: EdgeLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Edge length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Absolute length in the mesh coordinate units. The sequence stops when the next edge is strictly longer than this. Must be > 0 when this stop is selected.

IntVectorProperty.name: PreserveBoundary
IntVectorProperty.label: Preserve boundary
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON (default), every border edge is constrained and is not collapsed. A vertex on a constrained edge is not moved. Turn OFF to allow deleting border vertices.

IntVectorProperty.name: DetectFeatureEdges
IntVectorProperty.label: Detect feature edges
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON, CGAL detect_sharp_edges (Protection angle) marks sharp edges as constrained so they are not collapsed.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ProtectAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Protection angle
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Dihedral angle in degrees for detect_sharp_edges. Adjacent faces whose normals differ by more than this angle mark the shared edge as a feature. Used only when Detect feature edges is ON.

IntVectorProperty.name: PreventNormalFlip
IntVectorProperty.label: Prevent normal flip
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: CGAL Bounded_normal_change_placement. When ON (default), refuse a collapse that would reverse a neighboring triangle's orientation.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: DiscontinuityMultiplier
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Discontinuity multiplier
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Garland-Heckbert discontinuity multiplier (boundary / feature quadric weight). CGAL default 100. Shared by the three quadric algorithms.

IntVectorProperty.name: EndpointRanking
IntVectorProperty.label: Ranking
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: How the surviving original endpoint is ranked. Plane QEM: Garland-Heckbert plane quadrics at the two endpoints. Min angle: keep the endpoint that leaves the larger minimum interior angle. Placement is always an original vertex.

IntVectorProperty.name: Algorithm
IntVectorProperty.label: Algorithm
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: CGAL edge_collapse cost and placement. Lindstrom-Turk, the three quadric policies, and edge length + midpoint may move surviving vertices. Endpoint subset keeps an original endpoint and does not insert or relocate vertices.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseUpdateAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Interpolate attributes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, point/cell data are probed from the input onto the simplified mesh.
